t: Din mi shello diqdeq biqriat shema o lo hishmia leozno
s: Din mi shello diqdeq biqriat shema o lo hishmia leozno ubo g' seipim: ap al pi shetztzarik ledaqdeq beotiyyoteha, qara velo diqdeq bahen — yatza:

Yakol liqrotah bekol lashon, shenneemar: "shema" — bekol leshon sheatta shomea. Veyizzaher middibre shibbush shebbeoto lashon, vidaqdeq beotiyyotayv kemo bilshon haqqodesh. Vehu shemmebin halashon. Vehu haddin litpilla ubirkat hammazon. Abal qiddush ubirkot hammitzvot vehallel — yotze apillu eno mebin hallashon:

Tzarik lehashmia leoznayv mah shemmotzi mippiv, shenneemar: "shema" — hashma leozneka. Veim lo hishmia leoznayv — yatza, ubilbad sheyyotzi bispatayv. Abal im qeraah belibbo — lo yatza, shehirhur eno kedibbur. Umikkol maqom im hu anus sheeno yakol lehotzi bispatayv, kegon sheen hammaqom naqi beinyan sheeno yakol lehotzi bispatayv, dehaynu sheen hammaqom metunnap legamre — yesh lo leharher. Veap al pi sheeno yotze yede choba ella baamira — yesh lo leharher belibbo, vaHashem yireh lebabo veyitten lo sekar hammachashaba. Deamrinan hake bammidrash: "amaray haazina Hashem", amar david: ribbono shel olam beshaa sheani yakol ledabber — "amaray haazina", ubeshaa sheeni yakol ledabber — "bina hagigi". Va"hagigi" ratza lomar hammachshaba, sheim haya rotzeh lomar dibbur — apillu lebasar vadam en lomar "bina" bedabar sheshshomea, ella mittok sheeno ella bemachashaba amar leshon "bina". Veken nireh mehappasuq sheomer "bahagigi tibar esh dibbarti bilshoni", demashma shehaddibbur dabar echad vehammachashaba dabar acher:
